_about: Corrections from the Oct 2026 audit (Dead Sea Scroll citations checked against Ulrich DJD XVI / dssenglishbible.com and the scroll editions; dates aligned to Johnson's AM chronology). dss-cd-390-years-after-nebuchadnezzar.s: Ezekiel lay on his side 390 days for 390 years of Israel's sin. The Damascus Document (Qumran copy 4Q266; the medieval Cairo copy is CD) says that 390 years after God gave Israel to Nebuchadnezzar, he caused a 'root' to sprout; they groped like the blind for 20 years, then God raised up the Teacher of Righteousness. On Johnson's anchor of 3338 AM for the fall of Jerusalem, 390 years is 3728 AM (c. 198 BC); counting from 587/6 BC gives c. 196 BC.
